column1: # GTM Niche Discovery - Scoring Matrix Template (AIM-4686, 2026-08-06)
# Reusable spreadsheet. Methodology: docs/gtm/niche-discovery/playbook.md Part 6.
# HOW TO USE
# 1. One row per niche candidate that passed the 48h validation pass (playbook Part 5).
# 2. Columns C-G record evidence from the Part 3/4 evidence log.
# 3. Hard gate (column I): PASS requires G1>=2 (with a B+C present) OR >=4 via Method B,
#    AND G2>=2 AND G3>=3 AND G4=Y AND G5=PASS AND G6=PASS AND G7=PASS.
#    Any single gate FAIL -> candidate is DISCARDED (do not score).
# 4. K1..K6 use the 0/5/10 rubric below. Weighted score (0-100) =
#    The *10 rescales the 0-10 parenthesized sum to the 0-100 bands.
# 5. Decision bands: >=70 BUILD CANDIDATE | 55-69 WATCHLIST | <55 DISCARD.
# K-RUBRIC
# K1 Signal strength: 10=Tier1 in log, 5=Tier2, 0=Tier3 only.
# K2 Convergence breadth: 10=5+ communities, 5=3-4, 0=2.
# K3 Complaint density (Part 4): 10=4-5 competitors (or all mined), 5=3, 0=<3.
# K4 Gap buildability in 48h: 10=1 OAuth/CRUD, 5=1 integration+UI, 0=3+ integrations.
#    (integration = dependency on one external service/API)
# K5 Buyer concentration: 10=concentrated (>=20 named accounts), 5=50-200 reachable, 0=fragmented.
# K6 Price anchor gap: 10=30-50% below incumbent, 5=10-30% below, 0=parity.
